No actual meeting, quorum, attendance, commencement, adjournment, completion or failure is established. Whole-order-end and terminated fields are upheld only as expressly scoped in the exact rationale to fresh EO:506 scheduling authority; they cannot be consumed as extinction of all effects or as the parent lifecycle.

The complete April 3, 1905 commission resolution repeats the parent schedule/continuation and adds its own administration duties; it is not an intervening cancellation of the later EO:506. EO:418 and EO:474 concern compensation/travel; their complete held texts provide no conflicting schedule change and precede EO:506. No express savings or independent continuing command occurs in EO:506. The earlier parent saves consistent prior Panama Canal orders; the November 17 successor also preserves consistent orders. Neither savings provision creates fresh EO:506 permission to commence on a different later date.
